name: Jonas Pfeiffer

affiliations.role: Lead author of the original AdapterHub paper and co-author of the Adapters library

bio: Jonas Pfeiffer is a researcher at Google DeepMind who works on modular and parameter-efficient transfer learning for language models. As a lead author of the 2020 AdapterHub paper, written while at TU Darmstadt, and a co-author of the 2023 Adapters library paper, Pfeiffer helped build open tooling for sharing and composing adapter modules.
known_for: Lead author of the AdapterHub framework paper
